verification_summary.balance_notes: Race portland-council-d3 (21 candidates). Every candidate was searched in the same shared sources: the Mercury (2026-09-09), OPB (2026-10-07), the Tribune Q&A (2026-10-13), the Multnomah pamphlet and the 2026 AUD-120 forms. Legree has 3 bio and 5 position items (T1 pamphlet, T3). The website keir4pdx.com is printed in the pamphlet. Three AUD-120 versions exist but were not used, which is not needed given the pamphlet coverage. Incumbent=false confirmed.
